formal_specification.domain: Raw mutable metadata with literal UTF-8 String fields, exactly represented primitive integers/options, and raw notes/flags. Constructors and serde are candidate transport; validation observes without mutation.
formal_specification.parameter_rule: The five required strings are nonempty. Lan/Ran kind and formula strings are raw metadata; no end/coend or universal-property computation is performed.
formal_specification.failure: The first empty required label returns ArithmosError::InvalidShape(empty FIELD); then the stated parameter check returns its exact source-bound diagnostic. No successful mathematical certificate exists in this module.
formal_specification.profile: Exact primitive integer comparisons for levels, arity and bounds; literal string matching for tag-only metadata. No arithmetic, rounding, float conversion or normalization.

validate_shell.body: { if self.label.is_empty() { return Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape("empty label".into())); } if self.functor_f.is_empty() { return Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape("empty functor_f".into())); } if self.along_k.is_empty() { return Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape("empty along_k".into())); } if self.extension_functor.is_empty() { return Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape("empty extension_functor".into())); } if self.pointwise_formula.is_empty() { return Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape("empty pointwise_formula".into())); } Ok(()) }

invariant_argument: All public production bodies are mapped above. Constructors move explicit supplied values and store documented defaults; with_note appends only a raw note. They intentionally may construct a candidate that fails validation.

validate_shell reads required String lengths in the recorded order and then the declared threshold/tag predicate, changing no data. Every failed guard returns the existing typed InvalidShape variant with the original payload; every accepted path returns unit only.

The checked ordered-label model supplies acceptance and exact first refusal for the finite label list. There is no extra numeric parameter guard in this file; its integer/enum fields remain literal raw declarations. No theorem about universes or Kan extensions is exported.

Signed levels stay i32, unsigned level/arity stay u32, and the optional bound stays usize on the captured 64-bit target. Comparisons with constants do not overflow or divide. String operations/formatting preserve literal bytes, including whitespace, NUL and Unicode. No partial indexing, recursion, mathematical division or unchecked cast exists.
